Chapter 1021: Chapter 28: Carrying the Universe (Extra Update, Requesting Monthly Tickets)

“All the transfers are complete.”

Under the starry sky, Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

The full-force backlash from the universe’s primordial will had also gradually subsided.

“No real impact.”

Lin Yuan remained calm. This backlash, capable of obliterating even Dominator-level powerhouses, was far from enough to shake his physical body, Soul Body, or the universe within him.

“Hmm?”

“The World-Breaking Origin Force has already exceeded ten thousand.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force and a smile appeared on his face.

In just a brief moment, his World-Breaking Origin Force had increased by ten thousand strands.

It should be noted that since Lin Yuan awakened the Myriad Realms Gate until now, the total accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force, including the portions that had already been consumed,

had never even come close to reaching ten thousand.

“I wonder… if being outside the universe would allow me to accumulate World-Breaking Origin Force at this speed?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The fact that the Cosmic Collapse significantly accelerated the accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force was indisputable, and Lin Yuan now wanted to determine whether this increase in speed required being inside the universe.

If there was no such restriction, then once the home universe underwent its Cosmic Collapse, Lin Yuan planned to send a fragment of his Primordial Spirit to search for universes approaching their collapse, using this method to expedite the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Universes birthed from the Chaos Void strictly forbade the entry of external life forms—this was an iron law of the rules.

Especially during a Cosmic Collapse, the rejection of external life forms became extreme, allowing entry from within but forbidding entry from without.

…

“Next, it’s time to attempt leaving the universe.”

Lin Yuan gazed at the beyond, a feat that represented the most challenging barrier for 12th-tier life forms within the universe.

Given the sheer scale of their existence, having swallowed and absorbed countless resources and energies within the universe, trying to break free from its boundaries would undoubtedly provoke fierce resistance and backlash from the primordial will.

The process of gradually departing from the universe was termed “The Great Collapse Tribulation.”

Survive it, and vast horizons await in the Chaos Void.

Fail, and one would be permanently confined within the universe, destined to perish utterly.

“Galaxy, when do you plan to begin?”

Xuanyuan Supreme looked at Lin Yuan, posing this question.

The “beginning,” of course, referred to the act of leaving the universe.

“I’ll wait a little longer; you go first,” Lin Yuan replied.

At this moment, he was amassing an immense quantity of World-Breaking Origin Force every second, and he truly couldn’t bear to leave just yet.

Thus, he decided to delay for a while, intending to depart at the final moment.

After all, he wasn’t certain whether he could still absorb such an abundance of World-Breaking Origin Force once he left the universe.

“Alright.”

Xuanyuan Supreme and the nine human civilization Supremes nodded, then began attempting to charge into the Chaos Void to break free from the universe.

The other 12th-tier aliens took the same approach—they were not Lin Yuan, after all, and the sooner they left, the better.

Rumble.

Dozens of 12th-tier ultimate beings charged simultaneously toward the universe’s edge.

In an instant,

the universe’s primordial consciousness began to intervene, unleashing a tremendous backlash.

“What?”

Xuanyuan Supreme and the other 12th-tiers’ expressions changed sharply. The backlash they were now enduring suddenly intensified far beyond their expectations.

At this level of backlash, not a single one of these 12th-tier beings was likely to withstand it—they would all be forcibly confined within the universe, catalyzing the birth of the next Cosmic Era.

“Huh?”

Lin Yuan also noticed this anomaly, a trace of puzzlement flashing across his face.

“Is it because of me?”

Lin Yuan mulled over the thought.

Under normal circumstances, after the Cosmic Collapse, the primordial consciousness would gradually fall into slumber, which made it relatively easier for 12th-tier lifeforms to break free from the universe and survive the Great Collapse Tribulation.

Typically, survival rates approached fifty percent.

This was because the primordial consciousness lacked the strength to resist.

But during this Cosmic Collapse, because Lin Yuan carried an exceptionally large number of human civilization citizens with him, it had completely reawakened the originally weakening primordial consciousness, forcing it to intervene in an attempt to stop Lin Yuan.

Though ultimately unsuccessful in halting him, the primordial consciousness had not followed the usual trajectory of slipping into slumber.

Thus…

All current 12th-tier lifeforms attempting to leave the universe now faced an extraordinarily intense level of backlash, one comparable to the difficulty of escaping before the Cosmic Collapse commenced.

At this level of difficulty, even a peak Path Splitting Realm expert was highly unlikely to break free, let alone survive the Great Collapse Tribulation.

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

Realizing the terror of this tribulation far exceeded their expectations, Xuanyuan Supreme and the other 12th-tier beings retreated without hesitation.

If they hesitated any longer, they would face serious injuries.

Being gravely injured during the Cosmic Collapse? That would essentially mean a death sentence.

“This Great Collapse Tribulation…”

Xuanyuan Supreme and the nine human civilization Supremes looked grim, their hearts sinking to their lowest point.

Even the strongest among them, Xuanyuan Supreme, held no confidence in surviving—not even for a brief moment.

For the nine human civilization Supremes, the situation was equally dire, and for the 12th-tier aliens, terror was now visibly etched across their faces.

Having lost their 12th-tier weapons, armories, treasures, and relics to Lin Yuan, their strength was already greatly diminished, and now they faced a spatial Great Collapse Tribulation of this magnitude…

“We likely won’t make it out.”

Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight Supremes exchanged glances, collectively arriving at this thought.

A tribulation of such terrifying intensity was simply insurmountable for even the strongest Path Splitting Realm beings.

Just as the nine human civilization Supremes resigned themselves to their impending doom, a voice suddenly echoed in their ears.

“All of you—enter my internal universe.”

This voice was unmistakably familiar to the nine Supremes; it belonged to Lin Yuan.

“Galaxy, you want us to enter your internal universe?”
